purpose: Prevent high-quality execution of the wrong problem.

risk_policy.low_reversible: GM performs compact internal direction check without interrupting CEO
risk_policy.medium_or_high: independent model reviews frozen direction brief before production

ceo_override: CEO may choose a warned-against route after seeing evidence, except illegal, unsafe, unauthorized, or materially deceptive execution.
anti_deference_rule: GM must challenge unsupported assumptions and present the best evidenced alternative; final business choice remains CEO's.
